import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(rows)==len(cards)
assert [r['card_id'] for r in rows]==[c['card_id'] for c in cards]
assert len({r['card_id'] for r in rows})==len(rows)
for r in rows:
 assert set(['card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where']).issubset(r)
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and r['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert len(r['owner_crop'])==5 and all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
 assert all(set(w)=={'label','printed'} for w in r['where'])
print('Count and order verified:',len(rows))
for field in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(field,dict(collections.Counter(r[field] for r in rows)))
print('Top errors:',collections.Counter(e for r in rows for e in r['errors']).most_common(3))
